Announcement.description: A banner on all public pages, e.g. "Lightning: all matches paused until 14:00".
Announcement.title: Announcement

BlockAssignmentBody.description: All scheduled matches on a court that start in [start_time, end_time) get this referee.
BlockAssignmentBody.title: BlockAssignmentBody

CategoryBody.description:
An age class (e.g. "G10" or "J12") within a tournament.

`results_public` defaults to `False` for children's classes (age 12 and younger) and `True`
otherwise, following the NFF rules.
CategoryBody.title: CategoryBody

CupSetupBody.description:
The whole cup. Courts are added to existing ones; the time windows replace the existing
ones (unless empty). Only possible while the tournament has no classes and no stages.
CupSetupBody.title: CupSetupBody

CupSetupNames.description: Names of the created stages and stage items, in the language of the organiser.
CupSetupNames.title: CupSetupNames

DelayBody.description: Moves all matches that haven't been played yet and start at or after `from_time`.
DelayBody.title: DelayBody

DrawBody.description:
`pots`: the teams to draw, pot by pot (best teams first). One pot is a plain random draw.
`seed`: the same seed gives the same draw.
DrawBody.title: DrawBody

EntryFeeBody.description: Sets the entry fee (NOK per team) of several classes at once.
EntryFeeBody.title: EntryFeeBody

GameFormat.description: NFF game formats ("spilleformer"); smaller formats are played on parts of a full pitch.
GameFormat.title: GameFormat

Official.description: Only for the organiser: it has phone and email.
Official.title: Official

PlayingDay.description: A day of the cup in Norwegian time, with its playing hours, e.g. ["09:00-12:00"].
PlayingDay.title: PlayingDay

PlayoffBody.description:
One knockout bracket, e.g. "A playoff" for placings [1, 2] of every group. It can also take
the best teams at one placing across all groups: `best_of_placing=3, best_ranks=[1, 2]` adds
the two best third placed teams.
PlayoffBody.title: PlayoffBody

PlayoffPreset.description: No playoffs, one playoff for everyone, or A/B (/C) playoffs split by placing.
PlayoffPreset.title: PlayoffPreset

PlayoffsCreateBody.description: Creates a new stage after `group_stage_id` with a knockout bracket per playoff.
PlayoffsCreateBody.title: PlayoffsCreateBody

PublicDelay.description: A delay reported from a pitch; the public only sees the court and the minutes.
PublicDelay.title: PublicDelay

PublicMatchOfficial.description: What the public, the pitch and printed cards may see: the name only.
PublicMatchOfficial.title: PublicMatchOfficial

PublicRegistrationClass.description: A class open for sign-up, as shown on the public form (no personal data).
PublicRegistrationClass.title: PublicRegistrationClass

Registration.description: A team with its registration, for the organiser only: contains personal data.
Registration.title: Registration

RegistrationSettingsBody.description: Public sign-up for one class. Beyond `max_teams` teams, new teams go to the waitlist.
RegistrationSettingsBody.title: RegistrationSettingsBody

RegistrationStatus.description:
Teams created by the organiser are APPROVED. Teams that sign up themselves are REGISTERED,
or on the WAITLIST when their class is full. Both APPROVED and REGISTERED teams take part.
RegistrationStatus.title: RegistrationStatus

ScoreEntryMatch.description: A match as the score keeper sees it.
ScoreEntryMatch.title: ScoreEntryMatch

StageItemInputBestOf.description:
The `best_rank`-th best team of all teams at `winner_position` in the groups of a stage,
e.g. the 2nd best third placed team. Determined when the next stage is activated.
StageItemInputBestOf.title: StageItemInputBestOf

SuspendedPlayer.description: For the pitch page and printed cards: who may not play in this match.
SuspendedPlayer.title: SuspendedPlayer

Tiebreaker.description: Criteria to order teams with the same number of points, applied in the configured order.
Tiebreaker.title: Tiebreaker

TimeWindowsBody.description:
The periods in which matches can be played, e.g. 09:00-12:00 and 12:45-17:00 on both days.
Replaces all existing time windows of the tournament.
TimeWindowsBody.title: TimeWindowsBody

post.description:
What-if for a cup that doesn't exist yet: do these classes fit on these courts within these
playing hours? Plans the resulting matches with the real scheduler and tells what's missing.

get.description: The matches of a score link (no account needed, the token is the key).

post.description: A yellow or red card (classes from 13 years with public results).

put.description: The other team didn't show up: `winner_team_id` wins by the tournament's walkover score.

post.description: E.g. "we're running 10 minutes late": shown to the organiser on the schedule page.

get.description: The announcement as set by the organiser, also when it has expired.

Checks every age class against the NFF rules, e.g. at least 3 matches per team for the
13-year class and younger.

post.description: Make a tournament archived or non-archived.
A match host (kampvert) for a court during a period.

Setup wizard: creates the classes, their group stages and playoffs, the courts and the
playing hours of a new cup at once. Teams are drawn into the groups afterwards.

get.description: Cards, the suspensions that follow from them, the settings and the jury's log.

Summary of the cup for the application to the district (krets): playing days, courts,
classes, teams and matches, plus the facts entered by the organiser. Organiser only.

post.description: Logs a decision of the jury; with a card, it can add or remove suspended matches.

get.description: Who refs which match, by name only (no contact details): also for public pages.

put.description: Sets the referee and assistants of a match (replacing the current ones).

post.description: The other team didn't show up: `winner_team_id` wins by the tournament's walkover score.

get.description: Get the rankings for the stage items in the next stage of the given age class (category).
Officials with contact details, their matches and host blocks, conflicts and fees.

post.description: The official referees every match on the court that starts in the period.

delete.description: Also removes the official from their matches and host blocks.

Creates a new stage with knockout playoffs, e.g. an A and a B playoff, after a group stage.
Teams are seeded by their placing and teams from the same group meet as late as possible.

get.description: For the public pages: the current announcement and recent delays per court.

post.description:
Public sign-up of a team (only for a public cup, an open class and before the deadline).
When the class is full, the team goes to the waitlist.

get.description: The classes that teams can sign up for now, with the spots left.
All teams with their registration, including contact details (organiser only).

post.description:
Plans all matches like `schedule/propose` and saves the result. Matches that don't fit are
left without a court and time.

When the cup runs late: moves the remaining matches (of one court or all) by some minutes.
Returns the number of matches that moved.

get.description:
Problems in the current plan: overlapping matches, too little rest, matches outside the
time windows or on a court of the wrong format, knockout matches before their feeders.

post.description:
Plans all matches on courts and times within the time windows, without saving. Played
matches keep their place. Reports what's missing (courts or time) if not everything fits.

A link for entering results without an account, for one court or the whole tournament.
Owners and collaborators can create links: they run the match day. The token is in the
response only this once; the frontend link is `/score/<token>`.

Group draw: places the teams of the pots in the empty slots of the groups of the stage.
One team per pot per group, and teams of the same club apart where possible. Returns the
placements in the order they were drawn, so the draw can be shown team by team.

get.description: Returns the teams of the tournament, optionally only those of one age class (`category_id`).

The team withdraws: its opponents get a walkover in all matches it hasn't played yet; the
